claims.statement: November 6 Reuters reported JPMorgan estimates of global oil supply exceeding demand by 1.1m barrels/day in September and 1.4m barrels/day in October; prior-month bank assessment, not a new physical change dated November 6.

Vortexa's preliminary October Gulf exports estimated 14m b/d crude and condensate (~86% pre-war) versus 3.1m b/d refined petroleum products (just over half normal), excluding Iran; incomplete ship tracking could lead to upward revisions.

On November 6 Reuters reported Goldman Sachs judged oil inventories broadly unchanged in September-October, while prompt Brent CFD swaps moved into contango and January 2027 onward futures remained backwardated; these are different instruments and tenors, not equal evidence of product availability.

November 5 Reuters reported China end-October commercial diesel stocks at 11.1m tonnes, and forecast November diesel exports below 800000 tonnes; older report used as dated context, not confirmed November 6 export change.
